# Test R2: Public API exports
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT
print('R2 PASS: Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT exported')

# Test R3: Invoke and constants
from glom import Invoke
from glom import constants
print('R3 PASS: Invoke, constants exported')

# Test R4: Fill.__repr__
f = Fill('a', 'default')
assert repr(f).startswith('Fill(')
print('R4 PASS: Fill.__repr__ works:', repr(f))

# Test R5: Assign.__repr__
from glom import Assign
asgn = Assign('a.b', 1)
assert repr(asgn).startswith('Assign(')
print('R5 PASS: Assign.__repr__ works:', repr(asgn))

# Test R6: Coalesce.__repr__
from glom import Coalesce
co = Coalesce('a', 'b')
assert repr(co).startswith('Coalesce(')
print('R6 PASS: Coalesce.__repr__ works:', repr(co))

# Test R7: All public specifiers have __repr__
from glom import Check
c = Check(type=int)
assert repr(c).startswith('Check(')
print('R7 PASS: Check.__repr__ works:', repr(c))

auto = Auto('a.b')
assert repr(auto).startswith('Auto(')
print('R7 PASS: Auto.__repr__ works:', repr(auto))

iter_spec = Iter('x')
assert repr(iter_spec).startswith('Iter(')
print('R7 PASS: Iter.__repr__ works:', repr(iter_spec))

let_spec = Let({'name': 'value'})
assert repr(let_spec).startswith('Let(')
print('R7 PASS: Let.__repr__ works:', repr(let_spec))

invoke = Invoke(lambda x: x)
assert repr(invoke).startswith('Invoke(')
print('R7 PASS: Invoke.__repr__ works:', repr(invoke))

print()
print('All requirements verified!')
"
